side.label: Photo side
side.note: Which side the portrait sits on when there is room for two columns. On a phone it always comes first.

start.label: Photo on the left
start.note: The portrait first, then the story. The default, and the way most readers expect a profile to run.

end.label: Photo on the right
end.note: The story first, then the portrait. Use it to swap sides with a section above that also carries a photograph.
